title: Translate gameplay, issue, comparison and graphics reports into English
platforms: Desktop report HTML; headless Chrome on Linux with synthetic fixtures
changes: Translate fixed text, accessibility labels and JavaScript-generated statuses in the four remaining runtime debug report templates. Preserve report IDs, links, filter values, JSON keys, imported content and interactive behavior; comparison number formatting now uses English conventions.

Translate the four associated maintained guides while preserving old heading anchors, commands, source references, original in-game text, validation counts and the original acceptance limits. Update the English-first audit ledger and durable project state; whole-project migration remains partial.
validation: Eight Chrome checks passed at actual viewport widths 1400 and 500 for four public synthetic reports, covering gameplay filters/unknowns/contracts, issue status/links/Windows and POSIX command quoting/clipboard fallback, comparison field/audio/images, and graphics palette/tile/window/OBJ interactions with both relative images loaded. Four additional alternative-state checks passed for empty gameplay, compatible issue, matched comparison without artifacts and graphics without previous report. Screenshots inspected; structural IDs, links, sources, option values, classes and types match preimages. Evidence: target/english-first-project/reports-2026-11-02/browser-results.json.

Guide preservation checks confirm all four heading hierarchies, old heading anchors, existing links, CLI flag counts, original numeric tokens and the original Italian game quote. Evidence: target/english-first-project/reports-2026-11-02/guide-preservation.json. Menu language catalogs checked separately: English and Italian each contain all 378 entries.
limitations: Initial synthetic issue path and graphics click/VRAM fixtures were corrected; failed harness attempts and successful results are retained locally. Prior successful cases were reused rather than rerun. No ROM, save, recording, guest execution or native runtime build was used.

These templates are embedded at compile time; running executables must be rebuilt to pick up changes. Native Windows, other browsers, physical controllers and complete dynamic metadata are not newly validated. The larger English-first project still has pending guides and source areas.
